## Professional training

Since 2018 I have delivered public procurement training nationally as a
certified facilitator, and since 2020 I have assessed procurement competency as
a certified assessor. The training spans the levels of Indonesia's public
procurement competency framework and is delivered to central and regional
government institutions.

::::: {.entry}

::: {.years}

2018–

:::

:::: {.what}

[Public procurement — foundation level]{.role}

::: {.org}

Certified facilitator (LKPP). Procurement principles, planning, selection
methods, and contract basics for officials entering the profession.

:::

::::

:::::

::::: {.entry}

::: {.years}

2020–

:::

:::: {.what}

[Public procurement — advanced level]{.role}

::: {.org}

Certified advanced facilitator (LKPP). Procurement strategy, complex packaging,
contract performance, and problem resolution.

:::

::::

::::: {.entry}

2020–

:::
